title: The Grand Pavillion at Homestead Hollow

services.name: Corporate Events
services.desc: The Grand Pavilion Party Room accommodates approximately 70 people, perfect for small gatherings, bridal teas, conference meetings, and so much more. The Party Room has a beautiful crystal chandelier and matching wall sconces. The room is carpeted with a tray ceiling, crown molding and neutral color pallet. There is a large TV for media, perfect for corporate meetings. There are four restrooms, one of which is wheelchair accessible.
